text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to prohibit stopping at all times on the west side of Avon Avenue, between Avon Crescent and Humber Boulevard (south branch). The proposed prohibition will reduce parking related congestion and provide a safer environment for all road users in the vicinity of Santa Maria Catholic School.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times, on the west side of Avon Avenue, between Avon Crescent and Humber Boulevard (south branch). 2. Prohibited stopping at all times, on the west side of Avon Avenue, between Avon Crescent and Humber Boulevard (south branch).
